---
title: "Visualization catalog"
description: "Every visualization in the pool, with what the viewer does and sees."
toc: false
---

Each visualization has a catalog id (P- DPM teaching, M- method problems, C- DPprior
principle, A- evidence and real data, X- complementary tools), one sentence for what the
viewer **does** and one for what the viewer **sees**, the engine it runs on, and links
to its page and to a standalone version for slides or iframes. Filter by section, ladder
rung or audience; the [learning paths](learning-paths.qmd) string them into timed routes.
Ids are stable.
